title: Engineers report: T-002 Package 3 (T-002l, industry-neutral wording)
summary: The web UI now uses industry-neutral wording ('Operative' for the field worker) from one WORDING source in the shared package; the API, generated client and contract are unchanged and a wording test guards the chrome. T-002m (tree-surgery mock data profile) is optional and was not built. Reviewed together with Package 2 in review-t002-pkg23.
